title: Week 15 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “primary election”?
options: Constitutional powers allowing branches to limit or respond to one another.
A political system concentrating power and limiting meaningful competition, accountability, and civil liberties.
An election used to select party nominees or narrow the field of candidates.
The court’s authoritative resolution of the legal issue necessary to decide the case.
questions.explanation: Primary election means an election used to select party nominees or narrow the field of candidates.
